name: Defensive Throw [Combat]
body:
You have learned techniques to use your opponent’s momentum against them.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Reflexes, Improved Unarmed Strike, and Improved Trip.

Benefit(s): If an opponent misses you with a melee attack, you can use an attack of opportunity to attempt to trip them.
